title: Movement Stability of D-Optimal Sensor Placement Under Projector Perturbations
summary: In time-varying D-optimal subset selection, the number of replaced coordinates does not measure physical displacement: when the optimal selection for a set of mobile sensors changes, a single sensor may have to cross the entire graph. We therefore measure movement by a bottleneck matching distance on a fixed mobility graph, and define the distance margin at radius P as the smallest old-objective loss among configurations farther than P from the current maximizer.
